title: Cap. III Sol. Rat. 9: in execution God foresaw cruelty, Stephen's constancy, the crown
pass_a_gloss: But in the execution of this decree God foresaw the cruelty of the Jews, himself permitting, that would furnish Stephen the occasion of martyrdom. He foresaw at the same time Stephen armed with so great faith and constancy about to die eagerly and willingly for Christ. He foresaw finally himself, after this combat so nobly fought, about to give an outstanding crown of glory to this most brave soldier.
pass_b_english: But in executing that decree God foresaw the Jews' cruelty — which he permitted — that would give Stephen occasion for martyrdom. He foresaw Stephen, armed with such faith and constancy, about to die eagerly and willingly for Christ. And he foresaw himself, after that fight so nobly fought, about to give this bravest soldier an outstanding crown of glory.
source_text: Sed in exsecutione hujus decreti Deus praevidebat Judaeorum crudelitatem, ipso permitente, martyrii occasionem Stephano praebituram. Praevidebat simul Stephanum tanta fide et constantia armatum cupide et libenter pro Christo moriturum. Praevidebat denique se, post certamen hoc tam praeclare certatum, eximiam coronam gloriae huic fortissimo militi donaturum.
